device.description: 8-bit 2 MSPS dual-channel pseudo-differential SAR ADC with SPI interface
device.note: ads7947.pdf (SLAS708A) p.4 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions (DVDD 1.65 V to AVDD, AVDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.11 timing requirements, p.12 switching characteristics (tD1 14.5 ns, tD2 11 ns, tD3 15 ns at DVDD 1.8 V) and Figure 1, p.23 straight binary transfer function and PDEN, p.26-28 16-/32-clock frames (Figures 47-52)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the CH SEL pin level (low = channel 0, high = channel 1)

pages: p.4 (pins), p.5 (ROC), p.11-12 (timing, Figure 1), p.23 (code format, PDEN), p.26-28 (frames)
notModeled: analog inputs, reference and multiplexer settling; conversion is clocked by SCLK (8.5 SCLK, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)
16-clock frame pipelining (SDO shows sample N-1 while converting sample N): the 0 V code is constant, so the output is the same
bits after D0 in the 16-clock frame are undefined in the datasheet (shown as don't-care); modeled as 0
32-clock frame mode (CS held low to the 30th SCLK falling edge: the next frame outputs 16 zeros, then the data of the current sample)
PDEN auto power-down (PDEN high at the CS rising edge powers the device down after the conversion; CS rising with PDEN low wakes it): PDEN is an input with no effect
conversion abort (CS high during the first 16 clocks invalidates the next frame's data)
throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits
variants: ADS7947 (12-bit, tCONV 13.5 SCLK), ADS7948 (10-bit, 10.5 SCLK) and ADS7949 (8-bit, 8.5 SCLK) share ads7947.pdf and pinout; pin-compatible with the 14-bit ADS7945/6 (ads7946.pdf)
